entries.name: gold_jewel
entries.prompt: Create ONE small ornamental gold diamond finial from the top-center of the blue panel in the supplied UI reference. One delicate horizontal symmetrical gold leaf/diamond embellishment, about 3:1 aspect ratio. Thin warm gold lines, a tiny navy blue gem at the center, restrained elegant fantasy RPG UI. All space around the gold ornament is genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha. Absolutely NO rectangular panel strip, NO navy rectangular backdrop, NO background, NO text, NO border lines spanning the whole image. Only this ONE small gold finial ornament.
